exposure: Women with SLE, SPRA, and AS
outcome: Offspring death within 1 year of birth
cohort: 4,284 women with RDs and 26,023 age-matched controls
finding: Women with RDs, particularly SLE and SPRA, had an increased risk of pregnancy complications (cesarean section, TA, PB, PE/E, IGR) and their offspring had an increased risk of LBW and death within 1 year of birth.
mod_finding: Women with rheumatic diseases had an increased risk of cesarean section delivery compared to controls.
birth_weight: LBW more common in offspring of women with RDs
